WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    avg_unit_price,
    avg_bytes_per_ms,
    avg_bytes_per_ms - AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) OVER () AS above_all_album_avg
  FROM album_rates
)
SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, avg_bytes_per_ms, above_all_album_avg
FROM scored
ORDER BY above_all_album_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The all-album average is the unweighted average of each album group’s average bytes-per-millisecond rate; tracks with missing Bytes are excluded, and zero Milliseconds does not yield a rate.
